record.question: While calculating total lumens required in a lighting design, which of the following is of no consideration?
options: amount of natural light coming through the window
record.explanation: Total lumens for a lighting design is calculated as E × A / (CU × MF), using illumination level E, floor area A, coefficient of utilization CU and maintenance factor MF. Natural light entering through a window is not part of this standard calculation, so the 4th option is the one of no consideration.
